shadows.name: joined-overview

shadows.name: joined-record
shadows.purpose: The single low ambient shadow under the joined record pane.

shadows.name: dialog-lift
shadows.purpose: Reserved for the person form above its dark backdrop.

motion.name: state-standard

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Solid evergreen committed action with a quiet hover and visible keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 11px 16px; background: var(--navy-950, #123d2c); color: #fff; font: 700 13px/1.3 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 190ms cubic-bezier(.22,.75,.28,1), transform 190ms cubic-bezier(.22,.75,.28,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--navy-800, #245b43); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(234,179,8,.28); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: White bordered action for edit, cancel, and other reversible choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #bac7c0); border-radius: 6px; padding: 11px 16px; background: #fff; color: var(--navy-950, #123d2c); font: 700 13px/1.3 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 190ms cubic-bezier(.22,.75,.28,1), transform 190ms cubic-bezier(.22,.75,.28,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--navy-700, #317052); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(234,179,8,.28); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: Deep evergreen rail with a restrained translucent-white active state.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Primary"><button class="ds-nav-item ds-nav-item-active" type="button">VISITOR CARE</button><button class="ds-nav-item" type="button">ATTENDANCE</button></nav>

components.name: Directory Search
components.description: Solid search shell whose focus ring belongs to the complete icon-and-field control.
components.html: <label class="ds-directory-search"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"></circle><path d="m20 20-3.6-3.6"></path></svg><input aria-label="Search directory" placeholder="Search people"></label>
components.css: .ds-directory-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9e0dc); border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--surface-subtle, #f7f8f5); color: var(--ink, #24312c); transition: border-color 190ms cubic-bezier(.22,.75,.28,1), box-shadow 190ms cubic-bezier(.22,.75,.28,1); } .ds-directory-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--gold-500, #f4c430); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(244,196,48,.24); } .ds-directory-search input { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 400 16px/1.45 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Selected Directory Row
components.description: A compact ruled record line with the shared yellow marker and immediate selection wash.
components.css: .ds-directory-frame { position: relative; width: 320px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #d9e0dc); } .ds-directory-row { width: 100%; height: 76px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d9e0dc); border-radius: 0; padding: 15px 17px 14px 20px; background: var(--teal-50, #fff8d8); color: var(--ink, #24312c); text-align: left; } .ds-directory-row span, .ds-directory-row strong, .ds-directory-row small { display: block; min-width: 0; } .ds-directory-row strong { font: 750 15px/1.3 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-directory-row small { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--muted, #64716b); font: 400 12px/1.3 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-selection-marker { position: absolute; z-index: 2; top: 38px; left: 8px; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--gold-500, #f4c430); transform: translateY(-50%); transition: top 190ms cubic-bezier(.22,.75,.28,1), opacity 190ms cubic-bezier(.22,.75,.28,1); } .ds-directory-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(234,179,8,.28); outline-offset: -3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-selection-marker { transition: none; } }

components.name: Care Summary Cell
components.description: A square internal register cell that communicates state with label, metadata, and count.
components.html: VISITED1Last: recent visit
components.css: .ds-care-status { min-height: 100px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9e0dc); border-radius: 0; padding: 20px 24px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #24312c); } .ds-care-status svg { color: var(--navy-800, #245b43); } .ds-care-status span { font: 700 13px/1.3 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-care-status strong { grid-row: 1 / 3; grid-column: 3; font: 700 31px/1 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-care-status small { grid-column: 2; color: var(--muted, #64716b); font: 400 12px/1.3 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Solid Care Field
components.description: Readable solid field for care notes and other editable record content.
components.html: <label class="ds-care-field">CARE NOTE<textarea placeholder="Describe the support requested and the next responsible action."></textarea></label>
components.css: .ds-care-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink, #24312c); font: 700 13px/1.3 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-care-field textarea { min-height: 104px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #bac7c0); border-radius: 6px; padding: 13px 14px; background: var(--surface-subtle, #f7f8f5); color: var(--ink, #24312c); font: 400 16px/1.45 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 190ms cubic-bezier(.22,.75,.28,1), box-shadow 190ms cubic-bezier(.22,.75,.28,1); } .ds-care-field textarea:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong, #bac7c0); } .ds-care-field textarea:focus { border-color: var(--gold-500, #f4c430); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(234,179,8,.1); outline: 0; }

components.css: .ds-modal-backdrop { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 360px; padding: 20px; background: rgba(18,39,30,.62); } .ds-person-dialog { width: min(520px,100%); display: grid; gap: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9e0dc); border-radius: 10px; padding: 24px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #24312c); box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(18,61,44,.18); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-person-dialog header { padding-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d9e0dc); } .ds-person-dialog h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-person-dialog label { display: grid; gap: 7px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-person-dialog input { min-height: 46px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #bac7c0); border-radius: 6px; padding: 13px 14px; background: var(--surface-subtle, #f7f8f5); font: inherit; } .ds-person-dialog input:focus { border-color: var(--gold-500, #f4c430); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(234,179,8,.1); outline: 0; } .ds-dialog-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 12px; } .ds-dialog-actions button { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #bac7c0); border-radius: 6px; padding: 11px 16px; background: #fff; color: var(--navy-950, #123d2c); font-weight: 700; } .ds-dialog-actions button:last-child { border-color: var(--navy-950, #123d2c); background: var(--navy-950, #123d2c); color: #fff; } .ds-dialog-actions button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(234,179,8,.28); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Church Care Hub feels like one composed handoff register at a church welcome desk: orderly, discreet, and ready for the next ministry worker. The visual system makes operational continuity tangible through joined compartments, literal labels, quiet typography, and a restrained paper-and-rule material language.

Deep evergreen establishes trust and owns navigation and committed actions. SDA yellow stays rare and legible as the church mark, current-record wash, selection marker, current or Sabbath context signal, guidance state, and focus signal. Warm neutrals keep those roles separated, while compact density lets ushers move quickly without making a person feel like a metric.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous care register instead of a pile of floating cards.
Authenticated overview greetings paired with visible Eastern time and joined role-specific metrics.
Deep evergreen navigation and actions, with SDA yellow reserved for identity and state.
Quiet Plus Jakarta Sans hierarchy with plain operational wording.
Joined desktop panes and directory-first mobile stacking.
Fine mineral rules, solid fields, restrained corners, and low ambient depth.
Purposeful selection motion with an equivalent reduced-motion state.

rules.name: The Separated Signal Rule
rules.body: Evergreen and yellow never merge into a large blended surface; neutral paper and rules keep their semantic roles distinct.

rules.name: The Yellow Means Here Rule
rules.body: Use yellow only for identity, current selection, current or Sabbath context, guidance, and focus; its rarity is what makes it useful.

rules.name: The Workhorse Rule
rules.body: Let one sans family carry every role and make hierarchy through disciplined size and weight, never through decorative type.

rules.name: The Joined-at-the-Top Rule
rules.body: Directory and record begin on the same edge and share one seam on desktop; responsive stacking preserves their order and visual handoff.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use rules and tonal adjacency first; shadows never turn status, facts, forms, or history into a floating-card pile.

rules.name: The Outer-Edge Rule
rules.body: Round the enclosing register, not every compartment inside it.

rules.name: The Joined Overview Rule
rules.body: The role-and-name greeting, visible Eastern time, and role-sized metrics remain one contiguous register; the metric cells never become a colorful card row.

rules.name: The One Marker Rule
rules.body: One shared dot travels between records; never create a decorative marker per row or add selection spectacle.

dos: Do keep evergreen responsible for navigation, trust, and committed actions.
Do use yellow sparingly for the church mark, current record, guidance, and visible focus.
Do pair authenticated role-and-name greetings with visible New York time and joined role-specific metrics.
Do use ruled metric cells and small state dots, then stack them as one contiguous column on mobile.
Do reserve clickable care-focus panels for real next actions and render the empty state as static status.
Do preserve the joined-at-top register seam and compact directory boundary.
Do stack directory, selected record, actions, and history in that order on mobile.
Do keep editable fields solid, readable at 16px on small screens, and primary actions at least 44px.
Do preserve the shared selection marker, reduced-motion override, dialog focus trap, Escape close, and focus restoration.
Do keep the Cyventura footer compact and aligned to the bottom-right.
donts: Don't split the People workspace into a pile of floating cards or add gradients, glass, bevels, or decorative lift.
Don't split the authenticated overview into colorful floating metric cards.
Don't turn community mix into a progress ring or make an empty care status look actionable.
Don't blend evergreen and yellow across large surfaces or use yellow as routine decoration.
Don't replace literal operational labels with promotional copy, decorative kickers, or dashboard jargon.
Don't hide primary actions, introduce horizontal overflow, or reduce editable text below 16px on mobile.
Don't fabricate or expose visitor data in previews, screenshots, or design-system examples.
Don't enlarge, center, or otherwise promote the footer credit beyond its quiet closing role.
